source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

EPA zasílá své nejzávažnější občanské a trestní případy ENRD, která – jako relativně nedostatečně financovaný úřad – se často spoléhá na pomoc jiných agentur při rozhodování, které spory má řešit. Ve fiskálním roce 2022 EPA odložila méně případů ministerstvu spravedlnosti (88) než v jakémkoli roce od roku 2000 a uzavřela méně občanskoprávních soudních případů než kdykoli od té doby. source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

Před nástupem do EPA byl Uhlmann, asistent tajemníka EPA pro prosazování práva, v letech 1990 až 2007 dlouholetým vedoucím sekce ekologických trestných činů této divize. EPA zasílá své nejzávažnější občanské a trestní případy ENRD, která – jako relativně nedostatečně financovaný úřad – se často spoléhá na pomoc jiných agentur při rozhodování, které spory má řešit.
